newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila overnight money soars on C Bank move.
newsitem.headline: Manila overnight money soars on C Bank move.

text.p: *Banks await results of Treasury bill auction

Manila overnight money soared to an average of 20.09375 percent on Monday from 13.03125 percent in reaction to the seven basis-point jump in the Central Bank's overnight borrowing rate to 20 percent, traders said.
The Central Bank had used its interest rate to fend off speculation in the peso caused by the crisis in the Thai baht.
Done rates were from 21.46875 to 20.03125 percent, with 35 lenders and 22 borrowers.
Volume was higher at 18.04 billion from 9.58 billion pesos.
The secondary market continued to be quiet as banks decided to hold off from positioning ahead of the Treasury bill auction.
"Nothing's happening. We'd rather wait for the auction," a foreign bank dealer said.
Banks expected T-bill rates to rise after the Central Bank raised its key rates several times on Thursday and Friday.
